items.independentFinding: Finnish Environment Institute identifies Oulujoki from Oulujärvi to the Bay of Bothnia, 107 km. National Land Survey open OGC API line data is independent of OSM; geometry has not yet been checked for either Hydro ID. National Land Survey of Finland confirms independent watercourse line vectors sourced from the National Topographic Database, via open OGC API Features/WFS without API key and under NLS open CC BY 4.0 licence. Oulujoki official hydrology is already documented; live vector query and Hydro mainstem overlap remain untested. Published mainstem (416.298 km) is longer than the officially described 107-km Oulujoki reach; NLS official Oulujoki point is 1.964 km from Hydro centerline, versus 37.737 km for Siikajoki.

items.independentFinding: Finnish Environment Institute identifies Oulujoki from Oulujärvi to the Bay of Bothnia, 107 km. Neither metadata alone determines whether Hydro grouped route should display 남한강 for every fragment.
